title: Build a Cached Product Search API with Security Hardening and Automated Tests
spec: Build a full-stack product catalog application featuring a searchable REST API paired with a responsive query interface. The backend must implement a cache-aside strategy using Redis (or an in-memory store) with configurable TTLs and automated cache invalidation when products are updated. The application must enforce security controls including input sanitization, rate limiting, and secure HTTP headers, supported by a suite of unit and integration tests.
criteria: Caching logic is encapsulated in a dedicated service module implementing a cache-aside pattern with defined TTL constants and explicit key invalidation on write endpoints.

Web security hardening is visible through configured security headers middleware (e.g., Helmet), strict CORS origin settings, input validation schemas on POST/PUT endpoints, and parameterized database queries.

The test suite contains separate test files for unit tests (verifying cache key generation and validation logic) and integration tests (verifying API response codes, security headers, and cache-hit/miss behavior).
